2026 NLS dates

The racing calendar of the traditional Nordschleife racing series includes ten races at eight events. All races are held on the combination of the Nürburgring Grand Prix circuit and the legendary Nordschleife.

NLS calendar 2026


14.03.2026 NLS1: 71. ADAC Westfalenfahrt (4h)
21.03.2026 NLS2: 58. ADAC Barbarossapreis (4h)
11.04.2026 NLS3: 57. Adenauer ADAC Rundstrecken-Trophy (4h)
18.-19.04.2026 ADAC 24h Qualifiers (2x4h)
20.06.2026 NLS6: 1. ADAC Eifel Trophy (4h)
01.08.2026 NLS7: KW 6h ADAC Ruhr-Pokal-Rennen
12.09.2026 NLS8: 65. ADAC Reinoldus-Langstreckenrennen (4h)
13.09.2026 NLS9: 58. ADAC Barbarossapreis (4h)
10.10.2026 NLS10: 2. NLS Sportwarte-Trophy (4h)

for the races of the Nürburgring Langstrecken-Serie are available from the Nürburgring online shop, on site in the info°center and at the entrances to the open grandstands on the Grand Prix circuit and the paddock.
